text: Log your first LLM request in under 2 minutes by routing it through the AI Gateway
quote: Get your first LLM request logged with Helicone in under 2 minutes using the AI Gateway.

text: One line of code logs requests from OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK and other integrations

text: Logged requests show up in the Requests tab within seconds
quote: Once you run this code, you’ll see your request appear in the Requests tab within seconds.

text: Reach 100+ AI models with one API key through an OpenAI-compatible gateway
quote: AI Gateway: Access 100+ AI models with 1 API key through the OpenAI API with intelligent routing and automatic fallbacks.

text: Switch between 100+ models by changing only the model name
quote: Switch between 100+ models by just changing the model name

text: Bring your own provider API keys and use Helicone in observability-only mode
quote: use our AI Gateway with pass-through billing (easiest), or bring your own API keys for observability-only mode.

text: Pass-through billing where Helicone manages provider keys and charges provider prices with 0% markup
quote: Add funds to your Helicone account and we manage all the provider API keys for you. You pay exactly what providers charge (0% markup)

text: Automatic failover to other providers (e.g. Azure, Bedrock) during outages or rate limits
quote: When OpenAI goes down, your app automatically switches to Azure or AWS Bedrock using Helicone's managed keys. When you hit rate limits, traffic flows to another provider.

text: Routes requests to the cheapest provider first and load-balances across equal-cost providers
quote: Routes to the cheapest provider first. Equal-cost providers are load balanced.

text: Uses the same request parameters across providers, with the gateway translating them automatically
quote: Use the same parameters regardless of provider - the Gateway handles the translation automatically.

text: Generates images through the OpenAI-compatible API, with provider-specific translation
quote: Use the unified OpenAI-compatible API to generate images - the Gateway handles provider-specific translations automatically.

text: Handles requests that exceed a model's context window using truncate, middle-out, or fallback strategies
quote: Automatically handle requests that exceed a model's context window using truncate, middle-out, or fallback strategies.

text: Sessions group related requests so you can trace an entire agent flow in one view
quote: Sessions group these related requests together, letting you trace the entire agent flow from initial user input to final response in one unified view.

text: Path syntax represents parent-child relationships between requests within sessions
quote: Use path syntax to represent parent-child relationships

text: Test and deploy prompt changes without rebuilding or redeploying the application
quote: Test and deploy prompt changes instantly without rebuilding or redeploying your application

text: Reference stored prompts by ID in the AI Gateway instead of hardcoding them
quote: Use your prompt instantly by referencing its ID in your AI Gateway. No code changes, no rebuilds.

text: Track prompt changes, compare versions, and roll back instantly
quote: Track every change, compare versions, and rollback instantly if something goes wrong

text: Deploy different prompt versions to production, staging, and development independently

text: Playground UI for testing and iterating on prompts, sessions, and traces

text: Webhooks can be filtered so only requests matching specified properties trigger them

text: Rate limits by request count, cost, or custom properties to control usage and prevent abuse
